* '''PC-E3''' ([[Luke Skywalker, The Last Jedi (Errata 3)]], 19 August 2024): Players Committee card image, 19 August 2024: 0 side [[:File:V10-L-lukeskywalkerthelastjedi.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/a20089e/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/hires/lukeskywalkerthelastjedi.png Holotable commit a20089e “Virtual Set 10 Remastered”], no mark). Text: “Never deploys to a site opponent occupies. Deploys -2 to Ahch-To. Once per turn, may ▲ Force Projection. During battle, may cancel an opponent's just drawn destiny to cause a redraw. Immune to attrition.” '''What changed:''' Virtual Set 10 remaster: “to cause a re-draw” became “to cause a redraw”; new frame and copyright line. (The PC card data still reads “re-draw” and spells ▲ out as “take … into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”; this page follows the printed card.) '''PC transcription error:''' the game text changed but the card prints no errata mark (this is errata version 3, PC-E3); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].
